title: Fix numeric JS-call arguments captured as strings in serializeObject

comments.author: claude
comments.content: Delivered: reverted the strict-mode String(object) coercion in serializeObject (Extension/src/lib/js-instruments.ts) that was capturing numeric JS-call arguments as strings ([125,1,62,20] -> ["125",...]), failing test_canvas_fingerprinting deterministically. Fix is 'return object as string' — compile-time-only cast that restores master's exact runtime (raw primitive flows to transport JSON.stringify) while staying TS6-strict-clean; added a comment so a future strict pass doesn't re-introduce it. Verified: tsc 0 at #1195 and at the stealth tip, eslint 0. Also removed build-artifact pollution (bundled/stealth.js) + crosslink state (.active-issue) that an auto-snapshot had absorbed into #1195. Re-pushed all 3 stacked branches; CI re-running.
